about_blocks.text: Helix Healthcare Group offers a wide range of therapies for its patients. One of the most important therapies provided is 1-on-1 counseling that allows patients to work on their mental health problems with a professional counselor. Art therapy is another therapy that is provided, where patients can express their emotions through art. Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) is also offered, which enables patients to understand and change negative behaviors and emotions. Physiotherapy is also available for individuals who need to improve their physical health. Helix also offers Relapse Prevention Counseling to individuals who have suffered from substance abuse or addiction issues. Lastly, the center also provides yoga therapy that helps individuals to reduce stress and anxiety.

about_blocks.text: Helix Healthcare Group follows a holistic approach to patient healthcare. This approach takes into account the patient’s mental, emotional, and physical states. The center also utilizes medical treatment, which includes medications and other medical interventions to stabilize patients. The treatment is personalized, and every patient is treated on an individual basis. Helix believes in wellness rather than illness and, as such, all treatment programs are designed to achieve total wellness in patients.

about_blocks.text: Helix Healthcare Group specializes in treating substance abuse and mental health issues in patients of all ages. The center provides specialized treatments for various conditions such as alcohol and drug addiction, anxiety, anger management, codependency, sex addiction, and many more. The center has programs that cater to people struggling with chronic relapse, opioid addiction, and benzodiazepine addiction. Individuals who have struggled with synthetic drug addiction or lsd/ psychedelics addiction can also find effective treatment at Helix Healthcare Group.

about_blocks.text: Helix Healthcare Group offers a range of aftercare programs to help patients transition back into society after leaving the center. Follow-up sessions in-person with a counselor are provided to ensure that the patient is staying on track with their recovery. The center also provides family follow-up counseling to help family members understand and support the patient’s healing journey. Recovery coach programs are also available to assist the patient in their transition, and support meetings are held both on-site and off-site to provide continued support.

The facility has an unparalleled reputation for treating individuals dealing with various substance and drug abuse problems. Additionally, there are programs tailored to meet the unique needs of adults and young adults seeking treatment.
